items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: He said, 'Well, that's a clique,' but he said, 'I'll get you in two nights a week with me.'

ctx.x: Well, listen. We're running into our last half hour. When do you get to New York and the association with Prez Prez?

Well, I -- first of all, I got into Lips -- saw Lips, and he told me, said, 'Why don't you stay in town?' I said, 'Well, I want to, but I can't get nothing down on 52nd Street.' He said, 'Well, that's a clique,' but he said, 'I'll get you in two nights a week with me.'
